content: SOARM (SO100/SO101) has URDF/MJCF files in TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 and MuJoCo Menagerie, but is NOT natively supported in robosuite. Integration requires URDF→MJCF conversion, custom RobotModel subclass, controller config. Two calibration modes exist (mid-range zero vs horizontal zero). Adjacent/overlapping collision meshes cause large contact forces at init. Wrong inertia matrix (must satisfy A+B>=C) causes compile error. Malformed inertial blocks produce simulations that look correct but behave wrong.
